title: Workers run headless; Herdr is only the master's window
description: Real dispatch, CLI claim, worktree and watch across all 23 runtime kinds with one-task stub executables that commit and complete under their own lease, same-dispatch account handoff on a limit exit, retained redacted run logs served through the host bridge, and the item page listing runs by attempt. No Herdr call is made for workers.
